description: System.Text.Json converter that reads and writes RenderNode. A render node is a JSON object whose "kind" discriminates the node type; any other property becomes an attribute. The converter throws JsonException on a non-object node, so a malformed stencil pack fails at deserialisation rather than at render time. It is applied automatically through StencilJsonOptions.

examples.title: Deserialise a stencil pack
examples.code:
// StencilJsonOptions already registers RenderNodeConverter
var pack = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<StencilPack>(json, StencilJsonOptions.Default);
